36 likes, 0 comments - cerebellumacademy on October 16, 2026: "Some teachers just teach. Others change the way you think, learn and believe in yourself. 

Maybe it was the faculty who made a tough topic finally click. Or the one whose words stayed with you long after the class ended. Or the teacher who believed in you before you believed in yourself.

Every Arjuna had a Dronacharya. Who is yours? 

This is your chance to say the thank you they truly deserve. 

How to take part:
1️⃣ Create an Instagram post or Reel about your Dronacharya
2️⃣ Add your teacher and @cerebellumacademy as collaborators
3️⃣ Use #MyDronacharya and ask them to accept the collab

🎁 Every collaborator gets an Amazon voucher as a little thank you from us!

📲 Questions? WhatsApp us at +91 98715 18379

👇 And tell us in the comments: who’s your Dronacharya?

#MyDronacharya #Cerebellum #CerebellumAcademy #ThankYouTeacher #TeachersDay #GuruShishya #NEETPG #INICET #MedicalStudents #MBBS #MedStudentLife #Gratitude #MyMentor #DoctorsInTheMaking".
